name: Warpriest Cuachic
body:
Some warpriests follow old, bloodthirsty deities—animalistic avatars of sun and war that demand regular sacrifice of life and blood, empowering their warriors in turn.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Cuachics are prohibited from wearing metal armor and using metal shields. A cuachic who wears prohibited armor or uses a prohibited shield is unable to cast spells or use any of his supernatural or spell-like class abilities while doing so and for 24 hours thereafter.

A cuachic treats terbutje and great terbutje as his deity’s favored weapons for the purpose of proficiency and his class abilities, instead of his deity’s favored weapon.

This alters the warpriest’s weapon and armor proficiency.

Blood Drinker (Su)

When an adjacent opponent takes bleed damage as a result of a cuachic’s attack or spell, the cuachic restores an amount of hit points equal to bleed damage dealt.

This replaces spontaneous casting.

Defensive Instinct (Ex)

At 1st level, when unarmored, not using a shield, unencumbered, and conscious, the cuachic adds his Wisdom bonus (if any) to his AC and CMD. If he is wearing nonmetal armor or using a nonmetal shield, this bonus is equal to half his Wisdom bonus instead.

These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks and when the cuachic is flatfooted. He loses these bonuses when he is immobilized or helpless. These bonuses do not stack with the monk AC bonus class feature.

This replaces blessings.

Wild Shape (Su)

At 4th level, a cuachic gains wild shape, as the druid ability of the same name, treating his warpriest level as his druid level, with the following differences.

A cuachic can only change into an animal from one of these three groups: birds of prey, felines, ophidians. At 12th level, a cuachic can use wild shape to change into a Large couatl. When taking the form of a couatl, the cuachic’s wild shape functions as magical beast shape. A cuachic can never use wild shape to change into an elemental or a plant creature.

This replaces channel energy.

Lifestealing Weapon (Su)

At 4th level, a cuachic adds vampiric and greater vampiric instead of frost and shock to the list of weapon special abilities he can grant his weapon with the sacred weapon feature. He is considered to be automatically attuned to the weapon enhanced in this manner.

This ability alters sacred weapon.

Suncaller (Su)

At 7th level, a cuachic gains the ability to call down a beam of sunlight to heal allies and damage foes. This is a standard action with a range of 30 feet. A beam of sunlight has a radius of 5 feet. The area of the beam is brightly lit, as per the daylight spell. Allies of the cuachic that begin their turn in the area of this beam heal an amount of damage equal to the number of the cuachic’s fervor dice. Enemies of the cuachic that begin their turn in the area of this beam take an equal amount as fire damage instead. A cuachic can call down sunlight once at 7th level and an additional time every 3 levels thereafter, and the beam lasts for 1 minute each time.

The cuachic can call down this beam as a swift action instead of a standard action by taking bleed damage equal to his character level as part of the swift action.

Cuachics immune to bleed damage cannot use this ability as a swift action.

This ability replaces sacred armor.
